pr_body:
The main idea of this fix is to introduce `advanceToDoc` method in `SyntheticFieldLoader.StoredFieldLoader` to complement existing method in `DocValuesLoader`. This method is called for every stored field loader before stored field values are loaded (or not loaded) for the current document. As such it allows to discard stale data cached in loader when advancing to new document. The benefit of this approach compared to initial approach in this PR is that there is only one clear place where the "reset" happens and that's `advanceToDoc`.

We could follow up with a change to still provide `docId` parameter in `SyntheticFieldLoader#write`. That allows to assert that `docId` that was advanced matches the `docId` being written. That being said it's a fairly big change.

Closes #112156.
pr_title: Prevent synthetic field loaders accessing stored fields from using stale data

review_comment: Yes, it is possible that the field is both stored and has doc values. Composite loader merges data from all layers so that would not be correct.
Since you're touching this, add a short comment for `load` too.
Should this be moved to the loop below, right before calling `load`? I wonder if we end up advancing loaders that are not needed..

The loop below is executed only if there are values for the field in the current document, so if we do this there we have the same problem with stale values. We actually _want_ to advance all loaders.
